items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: But I am playing on Billy Taylor’s Mary Lou Williams Jazz Festival at Kennedy Center in May.

ctx.x: But I am playing on Billy Taylor’s Mary Lou Williams Jazz Festival at Kennedy Center in May. And they did ask me in this case to bring a female band. So I’m taking some wonderful female musicians. It’s such a good festival that I made the exception there because I think it’s promoting women in the right way, and I think it’s all about the serious women jazz artists. But I do try to stay away from that as much as I can. I do play with some female players, but they would be because I choose them, not necessarily…
Right. Because they’re good at what they do.
